description: Implement request queueing during cold start to prevent request storms during scale-up. Create engine/internal/gateway/queue.go with RequestQueue that queues requests when workers are scaling from 0. Per-group channels with configurable maxSize and timeout. Enqueue() blocks until worker ready or timeout. Drain() called when worker becomes ready. Integrate with Dispatcher.
steps: Create engine/internal/gateway/queue.go with RequestQueue struct containing: queues map[string]chan *queuedRequest (per-group), maxSize int, timeout time.Duration, mu sync.RWMutex
Define queuedRequest struct with ctx context.Context, flowID string, input map[string]any, responseCh chan *queueResponse
Define queueResponse struct with response *worker.ExecuteResponse, err error
Implement Enqueue(ctx context.Context, group string, flowID string, input map[string]any) (*worker.ExecuteResponse, error) - creates channel, sends to queue, waits for response or timeout
Implement Drain(group string, dispatch func(flowID string, input map[string]any) (*worker.ExecuteResponse, error)) - drains all queued requests by calling dispatch for each
Implement IsQueueing(group string) bool - returns true if group has queued requests
Implement QueueLength(group string) int - returns number of queued requests for metrics
Update engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher.go: add queue *RequestQueue field, initialize in NewDispatcherWithScaler
Update Dispatch(): if worker not ready and scaler starts scale-up (replicas was 0), enqueue request instead of waiting synchronously
Update engine/internal/gateway/scaler.go waitForReady(): after worker becomes ready, call queue.Drain(group, dispatcher.forward) to process queued requests
Add gateway_queue_length{group} gauge and gateway_queue_timeout_total{group} counter to GatewayMetrics
Create engine/internal/gateway/queue_test.go with tests: enqueue/dequeue, timeout, drain, concurrent access
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/engine && go build ./cmd/worker compiles without errors
go test ./internal/gateway/... passes including queue tests
RequestQueue correctly queues requests during cold start
Queued requests are drained and processed when worker becomes ready
Requests timeout correctly if worker never becomes ready
gateway_queue_length metric shows queued request count
findings:
Implemented request queueing during cold start:

1. Created engine/internal/gateway/queue.go with:
   - RequestQueue struct with per-group channels, configurable maxSize and timeout
   - queuedRequest struct holding ctx, flowID, input, and responseCh for async response
   - queueResponse struct carrying ExecuteResponse and error
   - NewRequestQueue(maxSize, timeout) constructor with sensible defaults (100 requests, 30s)
   - SetMetrics() to inject metrics collector
   - Enqueue() blocks until response received, timeout, or context cancelled
   - Drain() processes all queued requests using provided dispatch function
   - IsQueueing() and QueueLength() for status checks
   - ErrQueueFull and ErrQueueTimeout error sentinels

2. Updated engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher.go:
   - Added queue *RequestQueue field to Dispatcher struct
   - Updated NewDispatcherWithScaler() and NewDispatcherWithTracing() to create and wire queue
   - Updated Dispatch() to detect cold start (replicas == 0) and enqueue requests
   - Added isColdStart() helper to check deployment status via scaler
   - Added GetQueue() and SetQueue() for testing integration
   - Extracted forward() method for request execution (reused by queue drain)

3. Updated engine/internal/gateway/scaler.go:
   - Added queue and dispatchFunc fields to Scaler struct
   - Added SetDispatchFunc() and SetQueue() setter methods
   - Updated waitForReady() to call drainQueue() after worker becomes ready
   - Added drainQueue() helper that wraps dispatch function with group closure

4. Updated engine/internal/gateway/metrics.go:
   - Added gateway_queue_length{group} gauge to track queued requests
   - Added gateway_queue_timeout_total{group} counter for timeout tracking
   - Added SetQueueLength() and IncQueueTimeout() methods

5. Created comprehensive tests in queue_test.go:
   - TestNewRequestQueue - verifies defaults and custom config
   - TestRequestQueue_EnqueueAndDrain - happy path enqueue/drain cycle
   - TestRequestQueue_EnqueueTimeout - verifies timeout behavior
   - TestRequestQueue_EnqueueContextCancelled - verifies cancellation handling
   - TestRequestQueue_QueueFull - verifies capacity limits
   - TestRequestQueue_DrainSkipsCancelledRequests - cancelled requests are skipped
   - TestRequestQueue_DrainWithError - errors propagate correctly
   - TestRequestQueue_DrainEmptyQueue - empty/nonexistent queues handled
   - TestRequestQueue_ConcurrentAccess - thread safety verification
   - TestRequestQueue_QueueLengthAndIsQueueing - status methods
   - TestRequestQueue_MultipleGroups - per-group isolation

6. Added metrics tests in metrics_test.go:
   - TestGatewayMetrics_SetQueueLength
   - TestGatewayMetrics_IncQueueTimeout
   - Updated TestNewGatewayMetrics to verify queue metrics initialization
